svg.title: Bird Bend Stand wiring — sheet 3: Input cells, ENA diode OR (D-42), multimeter points
svg.text: Sheet 3 — Input cells, ENA diode OR (D-42), multimeter points
Polled at 1 kHz. ALM−, PEND− → logic GND. Default polarity: output conducting = low = OK
(and powered); open = high = alarm / unpowered / wire broken (drv.*_active_level).
External 4.7 kΩ pull-up mandatory (internal 30–50 kΩ too weak for a cable).
cell B — START (PB0) / END (PC1) limit, NC
EXTI both edges, level 1: stop on the FIRST edge, release debounced (io.release_ms 20 ms).
Closed = low = OK; open / wire broken = high = limit active (fail-safe).
3.3 mA wetting; silver micro-switches: pull-up 680 Ω if contacts misbehave.
cell C — E-stop sense (PA10), S0 NC block
EXTI15_10, level 0 (alone): open → TRUNCATE ≤ 100 µs, ENA disabled ≤ 1 ms, ESTOP latched.
M-6 at PA10: ≤ 0.4 V released / ≥ 2.3 V pressed. Internal PU 7–14 kΩ also on.
Bench STIM (J-STIM 220 Ω, switch unplugged) only per FW_test_plan §6.8 — M-7 ≈ 0.6 V.
EXTI9_5, level 1. Press = controlled stop (holding), PAUSED latched;
NO contact: a broken wire is not detected (KL-05) — test before a series.
cell E — DRV_PWR 48 V presence sense (PA7) — OPTIONAL, NOT FITTED in release 1 (wiring §7.2)
E = logic GND, C = PA7 node: low = driver powered.
(SAVE + reboot) → power loss stops motion ≤ 25 ms.
Release 1: unwired, PA7 reads high and is IGNORED
ENA: MCU drive OR hardwired E-stop cut (D-42, wiring §2.1)
MCU drive: stage 1 = PA4 direct · stage 2 = SN74ACT244 (5 V) output
E-stop path (D-42): S0 NO contact, no MCU element
internal 270 Ω / LED 1.2 V / Schottky 0.3 V / R_E / D1 / D2 ASSUMED
No contention: each source sees the other through a reverse-biased diode;
PA4 (TC, not 5 V tolerant) never sees the 5 V. +5V_CUT comes from the 48 V
bus (isolated DC-DC), so the cut works with the MCU in reset.
10 kΩ pull-down: MCU in reset + E-stop released → no LED current →
driver enabled / holding (D-13). The NO wire is NOT monitored (R-10)
→ periodic check C-25 at the start of every test campaign (D-54 e).
ENA LED current per condition (ASSUMED values, wiring §2.1)
a) enabled+rel. b) reset+pr. c) dis.+pr.
All input cells sit on the interface board (stage 1 perfboard, stage 2 SN74ACT244 shield,
R5 §5.2 Option A) with pluggable terminals; the internal MCU pull-up stays on as a backup.
Values from wiring.md §3, §5, §6, §7; parts are examples (1 % metal film, C0G / X7R).
component examples (S0 Schneider ZB5AS844 + ZBE102 NC + ZBE101 NO, or Eaton M22) ASSUMED
Input cells, ENA diode OR (D-42), multimeter points
